title: Threshold Breach Trigger: Serial Acquisition Engine Re-Ignites at Scale

Taking advantage of depressed software multiples, management deployed a record $1.6B in total capital ($809M completed in Q1 plus $786M committed for Q2), reigniting the serial acquisition compounding engine.
